stem_book: A disc of radius r is cut from a larger disc of radius 4r in such a way that the edge of the hole touches the edge of the disc. The centre of mass of the residual disc is located at a distance r/x from the centre of the larger disc, find x ?
reason: print omits the reference point; 'from the centre of the larger disc' added
work: hole centre at 3r: x = (r²·3r)/(16r² − r²) = r/5 → x = 5
